contract.interface:
An acyclic grammar supplies deterministic linear controls on F_2^D, fresh independent additive noise at EVERY occurrence, explicit polynomial/categorical marks, exact rational rates/weights and binary nested repetition. Singular controls are allowed. This extends the N738 compressed compound-Poisson endpoint family with once-per-slot discrete faults and arbitrary-degree EXPLICIT sparse polynomials. It supplies candidate full JOINT endpoint sampling, not trajectory output, physical calibration, coherent-error simulation, adaptive feedback or a demonstrated fast program.

Center each polynomial F at F(0), compile deterministic drift once, and push remaining marks through deterministic linear suffixes. Node summaries compose C_AB=C_B C_A and S_AB=C_B S_A+S_B. For any law J, independent J,J' and an unexposed fair B, J+B(J+J') has law J. A conditional affine-uniform state C+Uniform(W) therefore updates C<-C+J, W<-span(W,J+J'). The offset MUST update even when rank does not grow. A centered coefficient span inside W allows an entire noise occurrence/subtree to be skipped. Otherwise a nonconstant scalar degree<=d polynomial has disagreement probability>=2^-d between two independent inputs. At most D innovations imply expected<=D2^d active slot visits and a polynomial cap O(2^d[D+log(1/epsilon)]). Grammar traversal/persistent path-copy deletion pays depth per visited leaf without expanding repetitions; only noise occurrences are removed, controls retained. This bounded-degree discrete theorem is exact in the ordinary expected bit model, with no ideal real clock; its capped version pays TV error.

For explicit categorical supports<=s, center at a mode with probability>=1/s. If a heavy atom of mass>=tau survives outside W, the pair update grows rank with probability>=2tau/s. Process the WHOLE slot, including its offset, then remove that occurrence from a positive residual grammar. Expected visits<=Ds/(2tau). Once every heavy direction is absorbed, each residual outside mass<=s tau. Hidden heat-bath kernels P_i=I+p_i(K_i-I) and E_i=exp[p_i(K_i-I)] have local TV<=p_i^2 a_i(W); telescoping ORIGINAL prefixes and approximate suffixes charges expected rank increases<=D. The global replacement error<=D p_max, hence<=2Ds tau for residual categorical laws. The sharper local physical Bernoulli/Poisson comparison is q(1-exp(-q))<=q^2. Choosing tau~epsilon/(Ds), with compiler/cap error budgets, yields polynomial approximate endpoint cost without an initial dominant-zero/laziness assumption. This is not operator-norm approximation on every point state or infinite divisibility of every slot.

The companion compound-Poisson proof uses all-parity positive summaries for ACTIVE-MASS COUNTING; fresh conditional draws come from the ORIGINAL leaf law, never from the sparsifier as a physical noise substitute. For bounded degree, rejection outside W succeeds>=2^-d. Summary/descent error is O(DH rho), with polynomial preprocessing and explicitly allocated caps/clock precision. Finite clocks have density bound A and discretization error O(D^2 A Delta); log A and minimum positive stored-weight bit lengths, not numerical huge rates, set precision. The provided basis-peeling, generator and repeated-control scripts implement supporting identities, not the whole compiler.

For arbitrary-degree sparse leaves with m explicitly listed nonzero monomials, the KNOWN Karpinski-Luby inequality Z_ell=sum_{ell(c_A)=1}2^-|A|<=m^2 p_ell supplies importance proposals. Choose a monomial uniformly, force its variables to1, sample others uniformly; density h=(1/m)sum_true2^|A|, weight g=1/h. On an active cut g<=m^3 p_ell. O(m^3[D+log(1/delta)]/eta^2) samples give simultaneous relative parity summaries. Rejection with fresh proposals and g/(m^3 a_up) acquires the TRUE conditional outside mark in expected polynomial work. Degrees cost encoded monomial lengths, not2^degree. Discrete sparse slots use q<=Z<=m^2q, pair innovation>=2q/(m+1), heavy coefficients w_A>=tau/m and rank-budget Poissonization error<=2D tau. This is application of established sparse-polynomial counting, not invention of its FPRAS and not arbitrary succinct Boolean circuits.

A supplied arbitrary Boolean-circuit control iterated binary-exponentially many times already contains deterministic PSPACE simulation at zero noise; a general polynomial endpoint sampler with constant TV<1/3 would imply PSPACE subset BPP. This scoped complexity consequence does not exclude all structured nonlinear physical models. Relative rare-event precision, unknown noise acquisition, shared latent randomness and random noncommuting controls remain unsupplied. Polynomial claims have not been fully implemented, externally verified or practically benchmarked.
